context: For example, its capital, Prague, exhibits wonderful architectural styles, including Gothic, Baroque, Renaissance, Neoclassical, and Modern.

sentence: They believed that deaf children should learn by the Oral Method which involved lipreading and mimicking the mouth shapes and ( ___ ) patterns of speech.

sentence: As a way of assimilating the deaf into society, the congress declared that the Oral Method should be preferred to the sign method, considering what they perceived as the ( ___ ) of speech over signs.
explanation_zh: the superiority of A over B＝A优于B；over 是关键提示。

context: This opposition can be traced back to 1880, when the Second International Congress ... held in Milan banned the use of sign language in Deaf education.

sentence: They sometimes used JSL ( ___ ) under desks, hidden from the eyes of teachers.

sentence: In this respect, on the surface, this approach appeared inclusive of sign language; however, it had the effect of reinforcing the ( ___ ) status of sign language compared to spoken language.

explanation_zh: 前因后果：互相听不懂，所以沟通困难，用 , so 连接结果从句。

context: People of the Deaf community have diverse backgrounds, including the age at which they lost their hearing, the age at which they learned sign language, and the environment in which they were born and raised.
sentence: It should not be ( ___ ) that all the members of the Deaf community use the same language.
explanation_zh: It should not be assumed that ...＝不应想当然地认为……；背景多样，所以不能假定大家都用同一种语言。

explanation_zh: As（随着）从句用一般过去时，主句同样用一般过去时 returned；had returned 会表示“在水质改善之前就已回来”。

sentence: Nevertheless, it is important not to become ( ___ ) as the river continues to face environmental challenges.
